selection_rule: Filter distinct arXiv API records to publication date >= 2025-07-01, valid versioned arXiv ID, exact abs URL, nonempty title/abstract; exclude all IDs in E2/data/focal_papers.csv and all successfully scored focal IDs obtained by joining successful result case IDs to manipulation_plan.jsonl. Require duplicate source occurrences to agree on title, abstract, dates, URL and source. Rank eligible IDs by ascending SHA256("49|" + paper_id), tie-break paper_id; take first 50.
